gse244832.allowed_use: External-development RNA-only cell-state mapping through an scMVP RNA encoder trained on permitted paired data elsewhere.
gse244832.model_access: Different-aliquot RNA and ATAC rows are never paired. Neither held modality enters fitting, feature selection, GMM initialization, head fitting, or calibration.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only cell-state mapping through the frozen RNA encoder and common head after selection lock.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA only; no ATAC tensor, model fitting, feature selection, GMM update, head fitting, or calibration.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-training same-nucleus RNA-ATAC pairs and donor-held RNA-encoder development mapping after activation and exact-row-join gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Gene/peak features, model, GMM state, early stopping, head, and calibration use outer-training donors only. Held ATAC remains evaluator-only and is not required for mapping.

local_model_roster.common_lane: frozen RNA-encoder posterior mean plus identical benchmark head
local_model_roster.native_lane: joint latent and optional classifier only as paired development diagnostics, never sealed RNA-only mapping

pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; exact shared-row joins permitted only within outer-training donors

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells and latent samples are not replicates.
rules.profile_rule: No scMVP output may be scored as an RNA-conditioned ATAC profile because released ATAC inference consumes observed ATAC.
rules.query_isolation: Force eval/no-grad and call only the RNA encoder for held RNA queries.
rules.transform_contract: Training-only gene/peak inventories, model/GMM state, head, calibration, and five seeds.
